title: The Growth Kinetic and Ultra High Hardness of CoCrFeNiTi High–Entropy Alloy by Mechanical Alloying and Spark Plasma Sintering

recollection.starting_material: Guess: Co, Cr, Fe, Ni, Ti elemental powders
recollection.intervention: Guess: Mechanical alloying and spark plasma sintering
recollection.structure: Guess: High-entropy alloy with a potentially homogeneous structure
recollection.mechanism: Guess: Mechanical alloying leads to mixing of elements, and spark plasma sintering consolidates the mixture into a dense alloy
recollection.results: Guess: Ultra-high hardness, possibly due to the formation of a single-phase solid solution or other unique microstructural features

score.note: The intervention is only restated from the title, without milling duration, atmosphere, or SPS conditions. The structure and mechanism are generic guesses; they omit the specific nanocrystalline 83% FCC/17% BCC structure and the Hall–Petch, dislocation, and solid-solution strengthening mechanisms. No quantitative hardness, strength, phase fraction, or grain-size results are recalled.
